sinks.title: Django SQL Injection via queryset unpacking
sinks.remediation: Use explicit named fields: Model.objects.filter(name=value) instead of filter(**user_dict).

sinks.title: Django raw SQL
sinks.remediation: Avoid raw()/extra() with user input; use ORM filters or parameterized SQL.

sinks.title: PyJWT header validation weakness
sinks.remediation: Validate token type/claims; pin algorithms; reject unexpected header extensions.

sinks.title: Insecure deserialization
sinks.remediation: Never deserialize untrusted data with pickle.

sinks.title: Command injection via shell=True
sinks.remediation: Pass argv lists with shell=False; never interpolate user input into shell commands.

sinks.title: Code injection via eval/exec
sinks.remediation: Do not eval user input; use safe parsers.

sinks.title: Server-side template injection
sinks.remediation: Never render user-controlled template strings; use fixed templates with escaped variables.

sinks.title: Path traversal via open / os.path.join
sinks.remediation: Resolve paths under a trusted root and reject `..` segments.

sinks.title: Cryptography misuse / padding oracle class issues
sinks.remediation: Prefer authenticated encryption (AES-GCM); validate ciphertext before decrypt.

sinks.title: Pillow OOB read
sinks.remediation: Validate image type/size; keep Pillow patched; prefer framework abstractions with limits.

sinks.title: WeasyPrint SSRF via HTML/PDF render
sinks.remediation: Do not render untrusted HTML/CSS with WeasyPrint; disable remote URL fetching; sanitize input.

sinks.title: WeasyPrint CSS injection via presentational hints
sinks.remediation: Treat HTML/CSS passed to WeasyPrint as untrusted; sanitize presentational hints; upgrade WeasyPrint.

sinks.title: Requests .netrc credential leak via malicious URLs
sinks.remediation: Upgrade requests; avoid trusting user-controlled URLs; disable netrc (trust_env=False) when calling untrusted hosts.

sinks.title: sqlparse ReDoS on dollar-quoted literals
sinks.remediation: Upgrade sqlparse; do not parse unbounded user SQL with vulnerable versions.

sinks.title: sqlparse CPU DoS in TokenList grouping
sinks.remediation: Upgrade sqlparse; limit size of SQL strings before parse.
